speaker: Unknown
en: Global hiring is such a headache when you're building fast, but companies like Eleven Labs are scaling effortlessly with Deal.
zh: 当你快速扩张时，全球招聘真是让人头疼，但像 Eleven Labs 这样的公司正在用 Deal 轻松实现规模化。

speaker: Unknown
en: They quadrupled their workforce in 2025 without hiring an HR team.
zh: 他们在 2025 年将员工人数翻了两番，却没有组建 HR 团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Build your global team with Deal.
zh: 用 Deal 打造你的全球团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Visit deal.com slash MOS and start expanding your business today.
zh: 访问 deal.com/MOS，今天就开始拓展你的业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's D-E-E-L dot com slash MOS.
zh: 那是 D-E-E-L 点 com 斜杠 MOS。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a few hours, we get to see thousands of people that had this game on their bucket lists.
zh: 几个小时后，我们将见到成千上万把这场比赛列入人生愿望清单的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they're waiting outside.
zh: 他们在门外等着。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're wearing their gear.
zh: 他们穿着自己的装备。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as soon as they see us, they start jumping up and down and getting excited to high-five us.
zh: 一看到我们，他们就开始上蹿下跳，兴奋地要和我们击掌。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's not just players and cast.
zh: 而且这不仅仅是球员和演员。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's our staff.
zh: 那是我们的工作人员。

speaker: Unknown
en: They get excited.
zh: 他们也会兴奋起来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, you work for the team?
zh: 哦，你为这支球队工作？

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you can find that and continue to build that and talk about what matters most, it's not about the money, it's not about the sales, it's not about the revenue.
zh: 如果你能找到那种感觉并持续培养它，谈论最重要的东西——这不是为了钱，不是为了销售，不是为了收入。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not even about the growth.
zh: 甚至也不是为了增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's about the amazing moments that you get to create every day and feel that.
zh: 而是为了你每天创造的那些精彩瞬间，并去感受它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's the most contagious thing in the world.
zh: 这是世界上最有感染力的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is Masters of Scale.
zh: 这是 Masters of Scale。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Jeff Furman, your host this week on the show, Jesse Cole.
zh: 我是 Jeff Furman，本周节目的主持人，这位是 Jesse Cole。

speaker: Unknown
en: The name you may not know off the bat, but Jesse is the founder of the Savannah Bananas and Fans First Entertainment.
zh: 这个名字你可能一时想不起来，但 Jesse 是 Savannah Bananas 和 Fans First Entertainment 的创始人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you've turned on ESPN in the last year, you've seen the man in the yellow suit.
zh: 如果你过去一年看过 ESPN，你就见过那个穿黄色西装的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's Jesse.
zh: 那就是 Jesse。

speaker: Unknown
en: He's part P.T.
zh: 他一半是 P.T.

speaker: Unknown
en: Barnum, part Walt Disney, and he's scaling a whole new kind of sport with his fast-paced circus-style version of professional baseball.
zh: Barnum，一半是 Walt Disney，他正在用他那种快节奏的马戏团风格职业棒球，规模化一个全新的运动形式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jesse's relentless dedication to his fans offers important insights for anyone in the business of delighting customers, which really should be all of us.
zh: Jesse 对粉丝不懈的投入，为所有身处取悦客户这一行的人提供了重要洞见——而这其实应该是我们所有人。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are on location today.
zh: 我们今天在外景地。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are recording live at Angel Stadium, where the Savannah Bananas and the Indianapolis Clowns are playing tonight.
zh: 我们正在 Angel Stadium 现场录制，Savannah Bananas 和 Indianapolis Clowns 今晚将在这里比赛。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are with the greatest showman on earth, Jesse Cole.
zh: 和我们在一起的，是世界上最了不起的表演大师，Jesse Cole。

speaker: Unknown
en: Welcome to Masters of Scale.
zh: 欢迎来到 Masters of Scale。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm excited to be with you guys.
zh: 我很高兴和你们在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: Been a big fan of the show from when it first launched.
zh: 从节目刚上线时我就一直是它的忠实粉丝。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we've shared the episodes with so much of our teams, so many people on our team.
zh: 所以我们和团队的很多成员分享过这么多期节目，我们团队里有很多人。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's been great.
zh: 一直很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, we're Hoop fans, but you do.
zh: 好吧，我们是 Hoop 粉丝，但你确实也是。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we were just talking before we turned the mics and cameras on about how you all have been capturing content kind of Hoop Dream style for a long time now.
zh: 在我们打开麦克风和摄像机之前，我们刚刚聊到，你们长期以来一直在以某种 Hoop Dream 的方式捕捉内容。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're producing a movie of the bananas and fan first, and we might open on you leading the crowd and singing Coldplay's Yellow.
zh: 我们正在制作一部关于 Bananas 和 Fans First 的电影，我们可能会以你带领人群唱 Coldplay 的《Yellow》作为开场。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you set the stage for us so you can open the show there?
zh: 你能为我们铺陈一下背景吗，好让你在那里开场？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, as someone who grew up south of Boston, a huge Red Sox fan, my dad and I, you know, we went to so many games, back when tickets were $5, we'd sit out on the bleachers.
zh: 好的，作为一个在波士顿南部长大的人，我是 Red Sox 的铁杆球迷，我和我爸爸，你知道，我们看过很多比赛，那时候门票才 5 美元，我们坐在露天看台上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, I was a shy introverted kid growing up, and my dad...
zh: 你知道，我从小是个害羞内向的孩子，而我爸爸……

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, had the opportunity to win this challenge for me to become an honorary bat boy.
zh: 你知道，他有机会赢得一个挑战，让我成为一名荣誉球童。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so when I was five years old, I saw my first ever Red Sox game, but I was in the dugout before the game, but I was sitting by myself and one player came over and sat down next to me and it was Hall of Famer Lisa.
zh: 所以在我五岁的时候，我看了人生第一场 Red Sox 比赛，我在赛前就待在球员休息区里，我一个人坐在那里，一名球员走过来坐到我旁边，那是名人堂成员 Lisa。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he spent 20 minutes with me, this shy, introverted five-year-old kid.
zh: 他陪我待了 20 分钟，陪着我这个害羞内向的五岁小孩。

speaker: Unknown
en: He didn't have to.
zh: 他本不必这么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that moment changed everything for me because I saw him as this larger-than-life pitcher.
zh: 那一刻改变了我的一切，因为在我眼中，他是这位超越现实生活的投手。

speaker: Unknown
en: I saw the Red Sox now as this larger-than-life team.
zh: 从那时起，我觉得 Red Sox 是一支超越现实生活的球队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I vowed to one day play at Fenway Park.
zh: 我发誓有一天要在 Fenway Park 打球。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I put everything I can into my baseball career.
zh: 于是我把一切能投入的都投入到了我的棒球生涯中。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was fortunate to have professional scouts watching me on a Division I scholarship and then tore everything on my shoulder.
zh: 我很幸运，在拿到一级联盟奖学金时有职业球探关注我，然后我肩膀上的一切都撕裂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that ended my career.
zh: 那结束了我的职业生涯。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just like that, I was done.
zh: 就这样，我完了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that dream of playing at Fenway was over.
zh: 于是在芬威球场打球的那个梦想结束了。

speaker: Unknown
en: At least I thought until we started in the front office and how to make baseball fun.
zh: 至少我当时是这么想的,直到我们开始进入前台办公室,研究如何让棒球变得有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what people don't realize is spend 10 years with this team in Gastonia, North Carolina, that no one knew about just trying to craft what we were doing to get people excited about coming to a baseball game before we started the Savannah Bananas.
zh: 人们没有意识到的是,在北卡罗来纳州加斯托尼亚的这支球队里花了十年时间,没人知道那里,我们只是一心打磨我们在做的事,让人们对来看棒球比赛感到兴奋,这是在我们创办萨凡纳香蕉队之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we started the Bananas, failed miserably, lost everything.
zh: 然后我们创办了香蕉队,惨遭失败,失去了一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then after many years, made it successful, took the show on the road.
zh: 然后经过多年,我们做成了,带着演出上了路。

speaker: Unknown
en: And was able to sell out Fenway Park with 37,000 fans and everyone singing yellow and lighting up the sky.
zh: 并且能够在芬威球场满场售罄,37,000名观众,所有人一起唱着 Yellow,点亮了夜空。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was a moment I'll never forget.
zh: 那是一个我永远忘不了的时刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what happened was I got some coaching jobs, but I also got this opportunity to be an intern for a college summer baseball team.
zh: 事情是这样的,我得到了一些教练工作,但我也得到了这个机会,去一支大学夏季棒球队做实习生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And why would you want that?
zh: 而你为什么会想要那份工作?

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, well, it's right down the road.
zh: 我就说,嗯,它就在路边不远处。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's just try at the front office.
zh: 那就去前台办公室试试吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I realized immediately that in the front office, you could actually create a lot of the experience that happens for clients.
zh: 我立刻意识到,在前台办公室,你其实可以为客户创造出很多体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I started to get ideas of, wow, we could change this about the game.
zh: 我开始有了各种想法,哇,我们可以改变比赛的这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is boring.
zh: 这太无聊了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What if we had this?
zh: 如果我们有这个会怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: What about music here?
zh: 在这里放音乐怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: And so immediately as an intern, I started to get the idea of what it was like to work in the front office.
zh: 于是作为一名实习生,我立刻开始体会到在前台办公室工作是什么感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I got offered a job as a general manager at 23 years old.
zh: 然后我在23岁时获得了一份总经理的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Outside of a legendary baseball front office man when there was a year of yours, Bill Beck, did lots of the best, wonderfully the best things back in the 50s.
zh: 在一位传奇棒球前台办公室人物手下,他有一年时间在你这里,Bill Beck,在50年代做过很多最好的、极好的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But minor league and call them summer league is where we've seen at least some experimentation in baseball.
zh: 但小联盟,或者叫夏季联盟,是我们至少在棒球领域见过一些实验的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: What did you try?
zh: 你们尝试了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: What worked?
zh: 什么有效?

speaker: Unknown
en: What didn't work?
zh: 什么没效?

speaker: Unknown
en: Share that part of the journey.
zh: 分享一下这段旅程的那部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was 23 years old.
zh: 我当时23岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was two months into my job as a general manager.
zh: 那是我担任总经理工作的第二个月。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wasn't able to pay myself.
zh: 我没法给自己发工资。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was no money.
zh: 没有钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was $268 in the bank account when we started.
zh: 我们开始的时候银行账户里只有268美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there was no money.
zh: 而且没有钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: The team had lost over $100,000 the previous year.
zh: 球队上一年亏损超过10万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow.
zh: 哇。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I had saved money, you know, in college.
zh: 所以我在大学里攒了一些钱,你知道的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had a scholarship.
zh: 我有奖学金。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I was living off that.
zh: 所以我就靠那个生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was two months and I went to the VET conference.
zh: 过了两个月,我去了 VET 大会。

speaker: Unknown
en: What other VET conference?
zh: 什么别的 VET 大会?

speaker: Unknown
en: So the VET conference is Mike Vack and he brings together minor league operators and they talk about ideas.
zh: VET 大会是 Mike Vack 办的,他把小联盟的运营者们聚在一起,讨论想法。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all about ideas.
zh: 全都是关于想法的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So my mind started just seeing like, we got to think a different way.
zh: 于是我的脑袋开始觉得,我们得换个思路。

speaker: Unknown
en: I started reading about P.T.
zh: 我开始读 P.T.

speaker: Unknown
en: Barnum and Walt Disney.
zh: Barnum 和 Walt Disney 的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, you know, let's do the things that are just a little bit different.
zh: 我说,你知道,我们就做那些稍微有点不一样的事情吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, you have beauty pageants, but what if we had a grandma beauty pageant?
zh: 你知道,你们有选美比赛,但如果我们办一场奶奶选美比赛会怎么样?

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we actually got grandmas from a senior citizen home and had a grandma beauty pageant, which did not go exactly as we planned, but it was, it was.
zh: 于是我们真的从一家养老院请来了奶奶们,办了一场奶奶选美比赛,结果和我们计划的并不完全一样,但它就是,它就是。

speaker: Unknown
en: What happened?
zh: 发生了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I mean, Gertrude stole the show.
zh: 嗯,我是说,Gertrude 抢尽了风头。

speaker: Unknown
en: She was 87 years old.
zh: 她当时87岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, first of all, they showed up late because I, you know, I should have expected that.
zh: 首先,她们迟到了,因为我,你知道,我本该预料到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first question we did, uh, Gertrude, if you could be on the cover of one magazine, what would it be and why?
zh: 我们做的第一个问题是,呃,Gertrude,如果你能登上某一本杂志的封面,你会选哪一本,为什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: And she goes,
zh: 然后她说，

speaker: Unknown
en: I was, of course, Playboy.
zh: 我当时呢，当然是《花花公子》。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, this is a part of a lot of crowds.
zh: 我就想，这可是很多群体里的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to be seven years old.
zh: 你得七岁才行。

speaker: Unknown
en: No one should be thinking about that.
zh: 没有人应该想那种事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's how it opened.
zh: 事情就是这样打开局面的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we did that.
zh: 于是我们就这么做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, we had flatulence fun nights with whoopee cushion giveaways.
zh: 我们办过屁趣之夜，送放屁垫。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had salute underwear nights.
zh: 我们办过敬礼内裤之夜。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, we had garbage can nachos, which we're still doing in Savannah, like which five orders of nachos, three hamburgers, three hot dogs.
zh: 我们还搞过垃圾桶玉米片，现在在 Savannah 还在做，比如五份玉米片、三个汉堡、三个热狗。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's heart-stoppingly delicious.
zh: 美味到让人心脏骤停。

speaker: Unknown
en: Still can't get a cardiologist to sponsor it.
zh: 至今还没找到愿意赞助的心脏科医生。

speaker: Unknown
en: But all these things, we started thinking about how do we do things.
zh: 但所有这些事，我们开始思考该怎么做事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's where the experimentation lab started in Gaston.
zh: 这就是实验实验室在 Gaston 开始的缘由。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's one thing to say, I'm going to take the blinders off.
zh: 说我「要把眼罩摘掉」是一回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's something to actually generate the ideas for the grandma beauty contest or whatever else it may be.
zh: 真正为奶奶选美比赛或其他什么活动想出点子又是另一回事。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had nothing to lose.
zh: 我们没有什么可失去的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So people realize they always put so much weight on failure.
zh: 所以人们意识到，他们总是把失败看得太重。

speaker: Unknown
en: They put so much weight on an idea.
zh: 他们把一个点子看得太重。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we first started, you do something, who cares?
zh: 我们刚起步的时候，做点什么，谁在乎？

speaker: Unknown
en: It might not go right.
zh: 可能不会顺利。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we just kept doing all these different ideas.
zh: 所以我们就一直尝试各种不同的点子。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so now we've developed kind of a system on how we generate our best ideas.
zh: 于是现在我们已经形成了一套如何产生最佳点子的体系。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, we follow a Saturday Night Live model and we generate ideas on a Tuesday all day idea sessions.
zh: 我们遵循 Saturday Night Live 的模式，在周二进行全天点子会议来生成点子。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then we have a table read and we start doing rehearsals and we go through all that to have a brand new show every week.
zh: 然后我们做围读，开始排练，走完整个流程，每周做出一档全新的节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think when you take out the weight of that and just say, we're going to try things, you find out a lot more gold and you find gold because you're doing more.
zh: 我认为，当你卸下那份重量，只说「我们要去尝试」，你会发现更多的金子，而你能发现金子是因为你做得更多。

speaker: Unknown
en: You learn more by the more you do.
zh: 你做得越多，学到越多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so Henry Ford says, you learn by doing.
zh: 正如 Henry Ford 说的，你从做中学。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we're just constantly doing things.
zh: 所以我们就是不断地做事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, so back in the day, the first 10 years of Gastonia, there was no one covering us.
zh: 那么，早年在 Gastonia 的头十年，没有人报道我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was no social media.
zh: 那时没有社交媒体。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were just testing things and you'd watch how the fans react and you'd try it again.
zh: 我们只是测试各种东西，观察球迷的反应，然后再试一次。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's so many people right now who are working at companies.
zh: 现在有很多人在公司工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be massive, you know, Fortune 50 companies working at relatively early-stage startups who've had a plan.
zh: 可能是庞大的、你知道吗，财富 50 强公司，也可能是在相对早期的初创公司，他们都曾有一个计划。

speaker: Unknown
en: And whether it's because of AI, you know, other exogenous forces, external forces are coming in and forcing them to have to think different.
zh: 而无论是因为 AI,你知道吗，其他外生力量、外部力量正在涌入，迫使他们不得不换一种思考方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you talk to these folks, when they come to you, what are you saying to them about how to inject that, let's f***ing go of it, you know, into a process so that you take away that fear of failure and actually give yourself freedom to experiment?
zh: 当你和这些人交谈，当他们来找你的时候，你会对他们说什么，关于如何把那股「去他妈的干就完了」注入到一个流程中，从而卸下对失败的恐惧，真正给自己实验的自由？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, we had a plan.
zh: 是的，我们曾有一个计划。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were a college summer baseball team.
zh: 我们曾是一支大学暑期棒球队。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the plan changed because we watched what our fans were doing.
zh: 然后计划变了，因为我们观察球迷在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: We watched as fans were leaving games early.
zh: 我们注意到球迷们提前离场。

speaker: Unknown
en: No matter how much entertainment we had, no matter how much dancing, celebrations, crazy moments, surprises, our plan was to be a baseball team.
zh: 不管我们有多少娱乐节目，不管多少舞蹈、庆祝、疯狂时刻、惊喜，我们的计划是做一支棒球队。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why were they leaving early?
zh: 为什么他们提前离场？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because the game was too long.
zh: 因为比赛太长了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's too slow.
zh: 太慢了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's too boring for me both.
zh: 对我来说都太无聊了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a late night.
zh: 又是个深夜。
